candidate_relations.reason: The clinical presentation with monomorphic keratotic papules and the histopathology showing interface dermatitis with a prominent neutrophilic infiltrate and mononuclear histiocytoid cells are more consistent with neutrophilic lupus erythematosus rather than subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus. While anti-SSA/Ro antibodies are present, they are also seen in neutrophilic lupus erythematosus.
